Eliminating six moments gives z_1=-cTp(p+lambda)/(2abR) and the stationary Ito/Stratonovich signed area current Omega=-Tc^3(a-b)lambda(p+lambda)/(2abQR); an explicit positive polynomial proves R>0 for every parameter. The stationary stochastic contraction follows from both SPD drifts, and the sum of cross quadratic variations vanishes. For (a,b,c,T)=(2,1,1,1), differentiation gives exactly 3(7lambda^4+42lambda^3+51lambda^2-24lambda-36)/(21lambda^3+86lambda^2+105lambda+36)^2; the numerator has one positive root by Descartes. Independent exact-rational solution of the original six-by-six linear system at four parameter sets, including c<0 and a=b, matches closed form identically. Finite tests do not prove the unrestricted parameter theorem, which rests on the displayed linear algebra and positivity argument.
